title: Collateral selection after eligibility corrections
instructions: Use only the supplied synthetic information and the conversation history. Return strict JSON with question_id, turn, answers and evidence. answers maps every declared output to its typed value; evidence maps each output to a list of supporting source IDs available so far. Cite all and only the sources supporting that output; unsupported, unknown, repeated or future source IDs lose citation credit. Numbers use the declared units and tolerances; do not round intermediate calculations. Arrays require exact length and the requested order; strings use exact labels and booleans must be JSON true/false. Optional rationale is not automatically graded. Preserve prior constraints unless the user explicitly changes them. Distinguish stipulated scenarios from observed facts or forecasts. No trading, network access or proprietary query execution is required.
user_message: Choose the least-cost eligible posting for this one legal collateral agreement. All packet facts are synthetic. Use only sources released so far; cutoffs are inclusive unless explicitly stated otherwise. Recompute from the authored inputs, retaining every unamended constraint. Return the declared outputs and the supporting packet IDs; do not infer market probabilities or unstated permissions.

sources.text: Synthetic packet: The initial asset inventory, valuation FX and agreement schedule are authoritative for this account only.

Synthetic governing terms: Face equals market value in each local currency; FX is USD per foreign unit. Assets post only in five-unit blocks within available caps. Haircuts follow [USD cash, USD bond, foreign bond]. Funding rates are total one-period cash fractions, not annualized. Initial objective minimizes cost, then foreign units, cash units, and bond units. minimum_foreign objective minimizes foreign units, then cost, cash units and bond units. No collateral transfers or cash netting across unrelated agreements are permitted.
